Package org.tasktide.engine.policies.workflow

Class AbstractWorkflowStrategy

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.policies.workflow.AbstractWorkflowStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
WorkflowAcquisitionStrategy
Direct Known Subclasses:
RoundRobinWorkflowStrategy, SequentialWorkflowStrategy
public abstract class AbstractWorkflowStrategy extends Object implements WorkflowAcquisitionStrategy
AbstractWorkflowStrategy to hold shared operational logic of concrete WorkflowStrategyType instances. Enforcing a queue ordering based on the provided TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy
